thread:
maria_sales: Starting a short sync for VantaLabs POC identity expectations. They want SAML (Okta primary, Azure secondary), SCIM v2 (users+groups), RBAC mapping table, and domain-allowlist enforcement. They want a 2-week POC. Can eng/security confirm feasibility?

cory_cs: We can implement SAML + SCIM for a POC. For SCIM we'll do initial bulk import then PATCH deltas. Need the exact group->role mappings and any custom attributes they rely on (e.g., employeeType).

nick_eng: SAML support: SP-initiated & IdP-initiated, metadata XML, ACS URL, SP EntityID. We support signed assertions and audience restrictions. Example ACS: https://vantalabs-poc.redwood-inference/acs

anya_sec: Security questions: do they require encrypted assertions? assertion lifetime restrictions? For SCIM token rotation: do they rotate frequently? what minimum scopes?

maria_sales: They prefer signed assertions and might request encrypted attributes. They also want org-creation blocked for unverified domains.

nick_eng: We have domain verification via DNS TXT or admin email. We can lock tenant creation to a pre-approved domain list.

cory_cs: On group mapping: we'll provide a JSON template. We support nested groups if the IdP flattens them in membership. For POC target: 1 admin, 8 devs, 3 service accounts.

billing-bot: (automated) Note: Dedicated trial requires estimated monthly commit approval before provisioning.

anya_sec: Flagging potential blocker: per-tenant HSM/key isolation is Private-only. Also prepping SOC2 answers, encryption-at-rest details, and audit-log retention info.

maria_sales: Can we deliver SAML metadata + SCIM endpoints + mapping template by EOD? Customer kickoff Monday.

nick_eng: Uploading sample metadata and SCIM examples to /sales/vantalabs/identity. Quick sample metadata snippet:

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"urn:redwood:sp:vantalabs-poc\">\n  <SPSSODescriptor>\n    <AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://vantalabs-poc.redwood-inference/acs\"/>\n  </SPSSODescriptor>\n</EntityDescriptor>
```

cory_cs: I'll attach role-mapping JSON and a SCIM user CSV template. POC runbook: 1) exchange metadata, 2) verify domain, 3) bulk import, 4) enable PATCH provisioning, 5) validate roles, 6) optional Dedicated spike.

maria_sales: Thanks, team. I'll route billing approval if they want Dedicated spikes. :thumbsup:
